call_sites: reckon-paid-lanes.timer (user unit invoking the publisher CLI)

findings.text: the staleness flag is age > DEFAULT_STALE_SECONDS (3600.0 at :62) rather than the lane document's own suggested_shelf_life_* value, so a publish from a half-hour-old document reports stale=false although the lane republishes every 30 seconds and the stated criterion is older than its shelf life; falsified by publishing samples aged 18, 60, 600 and 1800 seconds, all stale=false.

the Host local block row quotes ceiling=21, headroom=8, gate_waiting=2 and kv_occupancy=0.33, figures no artefact in the run directory carries — host-publish.json records ceiling=20, headroom=7, gate_waiting=5 and kv_occupancy=0.32 — and no tool result in stream.jsonl contains any ceiling or headroom figure, so the row's numbers are unverifiable from the record.

the done_when names a Claude stream fixture, but the test replaces budget._newest_stream_reading with a stub, so no test feeds a stream file into the reader and the stream path's protection rests on the unchanged code alone.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 9d5f2815 commit by commit; 904d3baf adds the bounded rollout reader and its attribution plus the rate-limit translator and both tests, and b44fcb9d lands the plan comment and the evidence row at docs/evidence/archive/the-local-lane-is-the-default-landed.html:791.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a codex rollout fixture, a Claude stream fixture and a lane.json fixture, a host publish carrying a non-unknown reading per recent account plus a local-lane block, and the declared negative control; the rollout and lane fixtures are real files and the control is logged, but the Claude arm is stubbed at tests/test_headroom_publishes_real_readings.py:101 rather than fed a stream fixture.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is codex-family windows read from ~/.codex/sessions rollouts, the Claude stream path kept, and a lane.json occupancy block published; reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:639 reads the rollouts, reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:167 reads the lane document, and the stream reader is untouched.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, the node test recorded at two passed and the compatibility gate at 84 passed, the negative-control log path, and five changed paths; its artifacts line quotes a local-lane headroom=8 that the receipt it points at does not carry.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declaration names five files and a figures directory; git diff --name-only 9d5f2815 b44fcb9d names exactly those five files and nothing else, with the figures directory left unused.

justifications.durability: tests/test_headroom_publishes_real_readings.py:145 asserts the exact local_lane mapping from a fixture on disk, so remapping a lane.json key reddens it, but the hour-long staleness constant at reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:62 carries no assertion and no other test file names budget._newest_stream_reading.
justifications.evidence: the gate's Claude arm is stubbed at tests/test_headroom_publishes_real_readings.py:101, and the receipt the manifest names records ceiling=20, headroom=7, gate_waiting=5 and kv_occupancy=0.32 while the manifest and the evidence row quote 21, 8, 2 and 0.33.
justifications.fit: the new reader follows the module's composition style at reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:167, returning a document block injected at compose time, and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the published document carries a measured local_lane block and per-account codex readings (reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:167), but the staleness flag is computed against a fixed hour (reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:201) rather than the document's own shelf life.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path named by git diff --name-only 9d5f2815 b44fcb9d is inside the declared five-file scope, and no module outside them is touched.
